result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the four prior Story 4 blockers and the touched fork code/tests. Three prior findings are resolved; one remains open because fallback detection is still not proven as PI session-tree fork evidence, and one new touched-path fallback was introduced.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:307-310 now routes a pending session_before_fork hook without checking event.reason, and packages/pi-lhc/test/lifecycle/fork.test.ts:52-56 covers the startup reason case.

A fallback function now exists, but packages/pi-lhc/src/lifecycle/fork.ts:19-36 treats previousSessionFile or the last available entry id as fork evidence; it does not inspect the PI session tree parentId chain named by tech-design Flow 3. No current Story 4 test exercises hook-absent fallback detection.

packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:346-354 and 396-403 now make seed failure fatal for the fork path by recording a diagnostic, disposing the fork instance, clearing state, and returning instead of activating an empty fork.

packages/pi-lhc/test/lifecycle/fork.test.ts:159-184 now captures and forks with the same entryId, then packages/pi-lhc/test/lifecycle/fork.test.ts:190-200 asserts target work is pending rather than copied ready state and packages/pi-lhc/test/lifecycle/fork.test.ts:210-225 verifies both threads derive ready forms independently.

newFindings.title: Fork creation/init failure falls through to normal launch
newFindings.evidence: packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:325-330 records fork_thread_creation_failed and then falls through to normal launch resolution; packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:335-340 does the same after fork target init failure. Story AC-3.1 requires a fork to create a new LHC thread, and the real-code workaround standard does not allow replacing a failed fork with an unrelated normal launch path.

openFindings.title: PI session-tree fallback is not proven from fork tree evidence
openFindings.evidence: Story Scope In and TC-3.1 require PI's session tree as Epic 1 fallback evidence when session_before_fork is absent; tech-design Flow 3 specifically names the parentId chain. packages/pi-lhc/src/lifecycle/fork.ts:19-36 uses previousSessionFile and the last id/entryId from current entries or a parsed file, without checking parentId/fork relationship. The current fork tests do not exercise the hook-absent fallback path.

openFindings.title: Fork creation/init failure falls through to normal launch
openFindings.evidence: packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:325-330 records fork_thread_creation_failed and then falls through to normal launch resolution; packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:335-340 does the same after fork target init failure. Story AC-3.1 requires a fork to create a new LHC thread, and the real-code workaround standard does not allow replacing a failed fork with an unrelated normal launch path.

verified: AC-3.1/TC-3.1 hook path: session_before_fork data now drives fork creation even when session_start reason is startup, and the source event read-back remains unchanged in the focused test.
AC-3.2/TC-3.2 hook path: seedFork reads source events and writes replay events to the target thread, with focused coverage for seeded event read-back through the fork point.
AC-3.3/TC-3.3 v1 path: target forms are shown pending before drain and ready after independent derivation, with no copied ready source state.
unverified: TC-3.1 hook-absent fallback: no proof that fallback uses PI session-tree parentId fork evidence rather than previousSessionFile/last-entry heuristics.
AC-3.1 failure path: fork target creation/init failures currently fall through to normal launch resolution.

gatesRun.command: pnpm --filter pi-lhc exec vitest run test/lifecycle/fork.test.ts

productionPathFindings: packages/pi-lhc/src/lifecycle/fork.ts:19-36 implements hook-absent fallback with previousSessionFile/last-entry heuristics, not demonstrated PI session-tree parentId fork evidence.
packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:325-340 falls through to normal launch resolution after fork target creation/init failure.
additionalObservations: Focused fork tests passed: 1 file, 3 tests.
Configured story gate passed: 16 files, 82 tests.
